simple.meaning: תַּחָרָה (tachârâh) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to vie with a rival.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 2 times in Jeremiah, beginning at Jeremiah 12:5. Its meaning becomes clearer as the uses are compared.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to תַּחָרָה (H8474) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: תַּחָרָה (tachârâh) / H8474 is traced through Jeremiah 12:5, Jeremiah 22:15 with source-language evidence and verse context.
